summary.whatChanges: Adds two new exported TypeScript helper types, `inferSubscriptionInput` and `inferSubscriptionOutput`, to `@trpc/server`. The output helper unwraps async-iterable yields for generator subscriptions while returning the raw output for legacy observable subscriptions. Documentation and type-level tests are added; no runtime code changes.
behaviorChanges: `inferSubscriptionOutput` resolves to the yielded item type for async-generator subscriptions and to the observable value type for legacy observable subscriptions.
Docs page "Infer Types" now documents per-procedure and subscription inference helpers with an example subscription procedure.
risks: `inferSubscriptionOutput` relies on matching `LegacyObservableSubscriptionProcedure<any>`; procedures that don't fit either branch cleanly could infer unexpected types.
Type-only addition increases the public API surface that must be maintained for backward compatibility.
